funds.howTitle: How to get it into your account
funds.step1: On the exchange, buy HIVE. Most sell it for USDT, which you can usually buy there by card or bank transfer.
funds.step2: Withdraw it: choose the HIVE network and enter your Hive account name {{user}} as the address. Leave the memo empty: a memo is only needed when sending to an exchange.
funds.step3: It usually arrives within a few minutes. Each exchange sets its own minimum and fee.
funds.disclaimer: 3Speak is not affiliated with any of these exchanges and does not promote cryptocurrency. This is not financial advice: check the rules and fees that apply where you live before you buy anything.

prompt.title: Ads on your videos
prompt.lede: Ads run on your videos and you earn a share of what they make, along with the community you posted in.
prompt.intro: 3Speak can play a short sponsor spot in your videos. Here is the whole arrangement, with nothing behind it.
prompt.pointPool: {{pool}}% of what an ad earns goes to the creator side. The other {{rest}}% pays the people watching and keeps 3Speak thriving: encoding, storage, bandwidth and the people who keep it up.
prompt.pointDivide: That {{pool}}% is yours to divide. You can pass part of it to the community the video was posted into, so the community carrying your work earns from it too. Keep all {{pool}}% if you would rather.
prompt.pointViewers: Viewers earn {{viewers}}% too, and not out of your share. People who opt in are paid for the videos they actually watch, out of 3Speak's end of the split rather than yours. Your {{pool}}% is the same either way.
prompt.pointSayNo: You can say no. Turn ads off and your videos carry none at all. They are also withdrawn from what we offer advertisers, so nothing is sold that you opted out of.
prompt.changeAnytime: You can change either of these at any time in Settings.
prompt.allowAdsDesc: On by default. Off means no ads on anything you post, and no share.
prompt.shareCommunityDesc: How much of the {{pool}}% goes to the community you posted the video into.
prompt.savingNote: Saving stores this on your own Hive account, so the choice is yours and travels with you.

viewerPrompt.savedYes: You will earn a share of ad revenue for what you watch
viewerPrompt.saveFailed: Could not save that. Try again.
viewerPrompt.title: Get paid for watching
viewerPrompt.lede: You earn a share of what the ads make, for the videos you actually watch. Paid in HBD or HIVE, same as everyone else.
viewerPrompt.text: Ads on 3Speak pay the creator, their community, and now you. Your share comes out of what the advertiser paid, in whatever they paid with, for videos you were going to watch anyway.
viewerPrompt.note: 3Speak already keeps your watch history so you can find things again. This lets us use it to work out what you are owed, and keeps a record of how much of each video you actually watched. Say no and nothing changes. You can switch it off any time in Settings, and that deletes what we kept for rewards.
